app.name: Chroma test 480p + X2 1440
app.long_description: Chroma-subsampling torture test, 480p only. D-pad left/right switches between standard 480p and a double-horizontal 480p that outputs 1440 wide by duplicating every source pixel, so each pixel owns a full 4:2:2 pair and an FPGA can rebuild 4:4:4. The X2 mode reprograms the VI PLL to ~108 MHz; it is restored on exit and resets on reboot. D-pad up/down switches pattern. HOME or START exits.
